05
synthesis

Repeat impregnation and precipitation to saturation

Each cycle repeats impregnation, water rinsing, evacuation and H2S admission; it is not nine or six additional cycles. Saturation is reported after nine cycles. No final anneal, drying or isolation is supplied.

9 cyclesreported · Nine total impregnation–precipitation cycles, including the first cycle.
